documents.title: Corporate Action - Record Date For The Purpose Of Dividend For The FY 2025-26
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Notice Of The 19Th Annual General Meeting Of The Company To Be Held On September 25, 2026

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported a strong start to FY27 with revenue of INR 1,555 crores and an EBITDA margin of 35%. The company's order book grew to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows of 1,484 megawatt during the quarter. Emmvee is progressing with its 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion, aiming to reach 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by the end of FY27. Additionally, the company has outlined medium-term plans for backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing. Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 15,555 million and EBITDA margin expanding to 35%.

guidance.claim: Emmvee is targeting an EBITDA of approximately INR 2,400 crore by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

guidance.claim: Emmvee expects its total manufacturing capacity to reach approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by the end of FY2027.
guidance.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

guidance.claim: Management targets total installed capacity to reach 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027.
guidance.quote: Once completed, this will take our total installed capacity to 16.3 gigawatt for modules and 8.9 gigawatt for cells by the end of FY2027 financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects DCR demand to strengthen progressively during FY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect DCR demand to strengthen progressively during FY2027 as grandfathered non-DCR projects are completed and procurement aligned with ALMM requirements becomes more broad-based.

demand_outlook.claim: The tight domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells is expected to support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The order book reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that C&I has consistently been the fastest-growing sector over a long period.
demand_outlook.quote: And C&I has always been the fastest-growing sector in a long time, which you can see is similarly growing in our case as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that demand outlook for a manufacturer like them has been strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand outlook for a manufacturer like us has been strong.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion is progressing according to plan.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing 6 gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion continue to progress according to plan.

capex_expansion.claim: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, with hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed backward integration facility will have a total capacity of 9 gigawatt, planned in two phases.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed land allotment payments at Devanahalli, Bengaluru for its new facility.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also completed payment for land allotment at Devanahalli, Bengaluru and the land is now in the company’s possession.

capex_expansion.claim: IREDA sanctioned a term loan of INR 3,306 crores for the 6 gigawatt integrated facility.
capex_expansion.quote: IREDA has sanctioned our term loan for INR3,306 crores for this facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt in phases, planning the first facility in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And with that, we intend to set up an ingot and wafer facility of about 9 gigawatt integrating us fully in phases. And we plan to set up our first facility in FY29.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the wafer and ingot expansion is planned for a 5 gigawatt capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with the expansion, we’re looking at a 5 gigawatt expansion in Phase 1 and a 4 gigawatt expansion in Phase 2, which is going to be a year after.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin improved to 35% in Q1FY27.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The sequential decline in EBITDA was limited to 4% due to operating leverage, expense optimization, and increased internal cell consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Despite the sequential decline in revenue, an EBITDA was lower by only 4% quarter-on-quarter, reflecting operating leverage, optimization of expenses, and benefits of increased internal cell consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The PAT margin improved to 24% due to a significant reduction in finance costs to INR 11.1 crores.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter, due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The company guided an EBITDA of around INR 2.5 per watt for modules and INR 6.00-6.5 per watt for cells.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA per watt, I think what we had guided is around INR 2.5 per watt for just module, and for the cell it is of INR 6.00-6.5 per watt.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA for DCR modules is usually INR 8.5 to INR 9 per watt.
margins_costs.quote: DCR module is usually INR 8.5 to INR 9 per watt.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded to 34% compared to 31% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 34% compared to 31% in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 21% compared to 16% in FY2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current installed capacity is 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

orders_capacity.claim: Order inflow during Q1FY27 was 1,484 megawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our inflow during Q1FY27 stood at 1,484 megawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book increased to 9.9 gigawatt at the end of the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Consequently, our order book increased to 9.9 gigawatt of the end of the quarter compared to 9.4 gigawatt at the end of FY2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Effective module capacity utilization was 45% in Q1FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Effective module capacity utilization stood at 45% compared to 44% in both Q1FY26 and Q4 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: Cell capacity utilization improved to 83% in Q1FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Cell capacity utilization improved further to 83% compared to 68% in Q1FY26 and 79% in Q4 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book stood at 9.9 GW as of Q1FY27, providing strong revenue visibility.
orders_capacity.quote: Order inflow of 1.5 GW during Q1FY27 reinforced demand momentum, while the 9.9 GW order book provides strong revenue visibility for the coming quarters

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded an order inflow of 1,484 MW during Q1FY27.
The company has an installed capacity of 10.3 GW of solar modules and 2.94 GW of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Pure-play integrated module and cell manufacturer, with 10.3 GW of Solar Module and 2.94 GW TOPCon cell production capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company closed the financial year with an order book of 9.4 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: We closed the financial year with revenue of INR 5,049 crores, EBITDA of INR 1,734 crores, PAT of INR 1,082 crores and an order book of 9.4 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed solar module capacity increased to 10.3 gigawatt as of March 31, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our solar cell installed capacity stood at 2.94 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: For Q4 FY26, order inflow stood at 1.27 gigawatt.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been secured at a cost of less than 8%.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capital_allocation.claim: The capital expenditure for backward integration is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capital expenditure for the same is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The healthy order book and additional orders will help liquidate finished goods and raw material inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: With the healthy order book and we added another 1.48 gigawatt of additional order, so this will help us to liquidate the inventory also, both in terms of finished goods and raw material.

capital_allocation.claim: The capex for the 9 GW ingot and wafer facility is to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: To be funded largely through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised INR 2,900 crores through its IPO and public listing, including INR 2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We completed our IPO and public listing in November 2025, raising INR2,900 crores, including INR2,144 crores of fresh issue proceeds.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately INR 1,621 crores of IPO proceeds were used to prepay term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: We used approximately INR1,621 crores of IPO proceeds to prepay term loans.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt to equity stood at negative 0.06x as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of March 31, 2026, our net debt to equity stood at negative 0.06x.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company strategically kept more raw material inventory due to ongoing geopolitical issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: And added to that, this quarter we have strategically kept little more raw material inventory. Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place.

risks_headwinds.claim: The timing of the backward integration investment is subject to final clarity on ALMM List 3 and market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The timings of this investment will remain subject to the final clarity on ALMM List 3 and prevailing market conditions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rains in certain areas prevented customers from picking up materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of some rains in those areas, they are not able to pick up the materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company must apply well in advance to the DGFT for silver import approvals.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, what we have to do is now we have to apply well in advance to the DGFT for what is the import quantity we want to bring it.

risks_headwinds.claim: Wafers and ingots are currently almost fully dependent on China, representing a localization bottleneck.
risks_headwinds.quote: Wafers / ingots barely ~5 GW and almost fully China-dependent - the next bottleneck to localise

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes that competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, and logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.
risks_headwinds.quote: Competition will increase, technology will evolve, trade rules will change, logistic and commodity cycles may remain volatile.
